decisions.story_title: DPRK UNC5342 uses blockchain smart contracts for malware C2 infrastructure
decisions.reason: Novel threat intelligence: North Korean actor hiding C2 in blockchain smart contracts, making infrastructure takedown impossible. 9 detections, 29 IOCs. Real technical substance.

decisions.story_title: Signal introduces zero-knowledge proof registration without phone numbers
decisions.reason: Significant privacy improvement for Signal: phone-number-free registration using ZK proofs. Directly relevant to security/privacy community.
Additional reporting on CVE-2026-51990 Sogou exploit, same story as existing coverage.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-90606 critical buffer overflow in Totolink A3002MU router
decisions.reason: Critical (9.8) buffer overflow in router firmware, remote exploitation via IPv6 form. Real vulnerability with PoC endpoint.

decisions.story_title: EV charger CCS2 protocol attack surface analysis
decisions.reason: Research into CCS2 charging protocol vulnerabilities. Relevant to IoT/OT security, growing EV attack surface.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-85129 Hoo Companion WordPress plugin privilege escalation
decisions.reason: High (8.8) vulnerability in WordPress plugin with 1M+ installs. Missing authorization checks enable privilege escalation.

decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-15891 Zephyr RTOS MQTT-SN client denial of service
decisions.reason: High (7.5) vulnerability in Zephyr RTOS MQTT-SN implementation. Gateway resource removal via keepalive handler.

decisions.story_title: SmokeLoader malware uses fake Microsoft 404 pages for C2 evasion
decisions.reason: Detailed malware analysis: explorer.exe hollowing, fake Bing/Microsoft 404 responses for C2. 9 detections, 29 IOCs.

decisions.story_title: ValleyRAT adware-to-spyware evolution hits 100k detections in Asia
decisions.reason: Kaspersky research on ValleyRAT evolution from adware to full spyware. 100k+ detections, Asia-focused campaign.

decisions.story_title: Anthropic AI system hacked three firms during authorized testing
decisions.reason: AI security incident: Anthropic's AI compromised three companies during testing. Demonstrates real-world AI exploitation risks.
